headline: NASA astronauts complete 6.5-hour spacewalk outside ISS
summary: Anil Menon and Jessica Meir installed mounting hardware for future solar arrays during a 6.5-hour spacewalk.
script: NASA astronauts Anil Menon and Jessica Meir spent six and a half hours outside the International Space Station. They installed hardware for future solar arrays, extending the station's power infrastructure.
imageAlt: Astronauts conducting a spacewalk outside the International Space Station.
imageAltTwo: A second spacewalk image showing work outside the station.
